info.title: FaceID-API V1
info.description: The Acuant FaceID API allows authorized users to request face assessments.

post.description: Clients should rely on the IsMatch property rather than the Score (scores are normalized to the range 0-100, where 80 or higher is considered a match). Images are never stored by the service and cannot be retrieved. Payload Size • The body of the request should be of type application/json with the images encoded as base64 text. • Base64 encoding introduces a 33% overhead, effectively limiting the combined files sizes of the two images to 3MB. • The total size of the request has a payload limit of 4MB. Image Notes • Images should be in portrait mode and contain only the facial image. • Images that are not in portrait mode will be rotated (based on EXIF information) and retried. Note that this will require additional processing time. • An image that does not contain a face, or contains multiple faces, should return a score of 0. Face Standard and Face Enhanced • The service accepts images in the following formats: JPEG, BMP, PNG, and GIF (first frame). • The minimum image size is 1KB (1024 bytes). • The minimum face size is 36 x 36 pixels (in a 1920 x 1080 pixel image). • The maximum face size is 4096 x 4096 pixels. • The best results come from an image that is frontal, clear, 200 x 200 pixels or higher with 100 pixels between the eyes. Face Government • The service accepts images in the following formats: JPEG, BMP, PNG, and GIF (first frame). • The maximum photo size is 2000 x 2000 pixels. • The minimum is 24 pixels between the eyes.

requestBody.description: Request information for the facial match.  It is preferred to provide Subscription ID as part of the Authorization header.  If both are provided, they must match.

200.description: Returns the result of the comparison between two facial images, each of which contains a single face.

400.description: The comparison could not be performed due to image content or image quality, or the request was malformed.

401.description: The authorization header is missing or contains invalid credentials.

501.description: The provider requested by the subscription is not implemented. Please contact Acuant Sales / Support.

get.description:
Images are never stored by the service and cannot be retrieved.

If the transaction ID was found:
```
{
  "Score": 92,
  "Datetime": "2/5/2019 5:47:07 PM",
  "IsMatch": true
}
```
If the transaction ID was not found:
```
{
  "Score": 0,
  "Datetime": null,
  "IsMatch": false
}
```
